## Natural history notes

A medium-sized dragonlet characterized by its slender body, clear wings with a broad dark band across each wing, and dark brown to black abdomen often marked with pale or bluish coloration depending on sex and age. In Florida, it is found around ponds, lakes, marshes, canals, ditches, wet prairies, and other sunny freshwater wetlands with open edges and emergent vegetation. Adults perch on twigs, reeds, or low vegetation and make short flights to catch small flying insects, while the aquatic nymphs live in shallow water among plants and debris where they prey on small aquatic invertebrates.
